title: App Store screenshots, set S-V2 (editorial)
brief: Six App Store screenshots for iPhone 6.9" (1320 × 2868 PNG, no alpha) in a bright high-fashion magazine look: oversized two-tone Geist headlines (key phrase Primary Black, the rest grey, like the app's front door), big real photography of Emma, her own garments as cut-outs with real shadows, the real build-284 screens in Apple's iPhone bezel. Colour comes from the photos, never from painted fields. One message per screenshot, the outcome not the feature (Scrnsht Studio's 7 principles, pasted by the founder 2026-10-24): 1 Always know what to wear. 2 Your closet, from your photos. 3 See it on you. 4 A look for every day. 5 Ask your stylist. 6 Your photos stay yours. (the app's own privacy-shield words). No ratings, reviews or claims we can't back.
hook: Screenshot 1 is the value prop: a full-width magazine photo of Emma in her camel coat under 'Always know / what to wear.', her look laid out below it. The first three read as a row in search results at 25%.
disclosures: iPhone is a trademark of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries.
Emma is an AI-generated persona and her photos are AI-generated.
